activities.Instructions: Use established skating and stopping skills while guiding the puck along the marked route. Keep separation from others and slow before turns.
activities.Tracking measures: Route completions; control losses; time; rest
activities.Load convention: Record stick and puck type
activities.Setup to record: Route; surface; pace; skating skill; protection
activities.Reference scope: Stickhandling-family reference only; full page could not be retrieved during this review. It does not establish an off-ice to on-ice difficulty ranking.
activities.Space / facility requirements: Managed ice rink with marked non-contact lane
activities.Starting position: Standing on skates in hockey stance
activities.Supervision / instruction needs: Rink supervision and prior skating instruction
activities.Selection / alternative notes: Requires skating and stopping skills plus rink access. Off-ice control is related practice, not an automatic easier substitute. Low impact excludes collisions and falls.
